query_parsed: List some slang terms for male genitals.
ai_generated_output_text: Slang terms for male genitals vary widely depending on the region, culture, and the level of "politeness" intended. Here is a breakdown of some common terms categorized by their general usage.Common & DirectThese are the most frequent terms you’ll encounter in casual conversation or media:Dick: The most ubiquitous slang term in English.Cock: Very common, often considered slightly more graphic than "dick."Prick: Often used both as a descriptor and as an insult for a person.Pecker: A slightly older, somewhat more "folksy" American term.Schlong: Derived from the Yiddish word shlang (meaning snake).Playful or EuphemisticThese are often used to soften the impact or add a bit of humor:Wiener/Willy: Common "playground" terms or used when speaking to/around children.Johnson: Popularized largely by 90s pop culture (notably The Big Lebowski).Peter: An old-fashioned euphemism.Tool: Often used in a more "functional" or masculine context.Unit: Usually implies a larger size.British & Commonwealth SlangThe UK and Australia have a specific set of colorful alternatives:Willy: The standard polite-ish term in the UK.Nob/Knob: Very common British slang; also used as an insult.Donger: Frequently used in Australian slang.Tallywhacker: A more whimsical, older British/Southern US term.Anatomical Slang (Testicles)If you are referring specifically to the testicles, common slang includes:Balls / Nuts: The standard go-to terms.Junk: Usually refers to the entire package (penis and testicles).Family Jewels: A classic euphemism implying value.Gonads: Though technically a biological term, it is frequently used as slang.Note: Because slang is constantly evolving, terms can go from being "cool" to "cringe" or even offensive very quickly depending on the social context.
